docs.title: ABC
docs.text:
Bananas *This is a test line` - banana fish Attribute Arguments

  • <argument> - Required Argument
  • {optional} - Optional Argument
Tool Attribute Description Applies Usage AUTO_COLLECT automatically teleports items into the player's inventory GLOBAL AUTO_COLLECT AUTO_SELL automatically sells item in tool inventory(requires vault) GLOBAL AUTO_SELL DROP_BOOST increases the amount of items dropped GLOBAL AUTO_COLLECT DROP_ITEM drops an item when activated GLOBAL DROP_ITEM EXPERIENCE_MULTIPLIER makes the tool gain experience faster GLOBAL EXPERIENCE_MULTIPLIER:<multiplier> MESSAGE messages the player GLOBAL POTION_EFFECT gives the player a potion effect while holding the item GLOBAL UNBREAKABLE prevents the item from losing durability GLOBAL AUTO_COLLECT BLACKSMITH restores durability while mining PICKAXE BLASTING destroys all blocks in a radius PICKAXE BLASTING:<radius>:{radius} DESTROY_ORES when true, the blasting tools will break ores PICKAXE FORGE restores durability to all items in inventory PICKAXE GEOLOGIST chance to discover bonus minerals when mining stone PICKAXE OBSIDIAN_DESTROYER chance to instantly break obsidian PICKAXE ORE_SENSE creates a path to nearby ores PICKAXE SMELT_ORES automatically smelts ores when broken PICKAXE VEIN_MINER mines all ores in a vein PICKAXE AREA_HARVEST Harvests crops in an area PICKAXE AREA_HARVEST:<radius>:<chance> BOUNTIFUL_HARVEST generates extra crops PICKAXE BOUNTIFUL_HARVEST:<multiplier>:<chance> CHAIN_HARVEST destroys crops in a snake like manner PICKAXE CHAIN_HARVEST:<max_blocks>:<chance> CROP_FORTUNE increases the amount of crops dropped by crops PICKAXE CROP_FORTUNE:<amount> FERTILE_TOUCH upon harvesting a crop, nearby crops have a chance to advance in growth PICKAXE FERITLE_TOUCH:<power>:<radius>:<max_crops>:<chance> INSTANT_HARVEST harvests any crop type instantly INSTANT_REGROWTH chance to instantly regrow a broken crop PICKAXE INSTANT_REGROWTH:<chance> REJUVENATING_PULSE creates a circle that grows nearby crops when activated PICKAXE REJUVINATING_PULSE:<power>:<radius>:<duration>:<chance>:<cooldown> REPLANT_SEEDS Automatically replant seeds if they are in the player's inventory PICKAXE REPLANT_SEEDS:<chance> REQUIRE_MATURE when true, allows a harvester tool to only break fully grown crops PICKAXE REQUIRE_MATURE:<true/false>

docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.
